## Featured: OmaSafe (2026)

Trust and security tooling for Omarchy Linux. Omarchy plugins are QML/JavaScript loaded unsandboxed with full user permissions from mutable Git repositories; the marketplace validates one commit at listing time. OmaSafe closes the gap between what was validated once and what is running now. It never executes plugin code, runs unprivileged, and never produces a single safety score.

- **omasafe-cli** (Rust, v0.3.1): plugin inventory, marketplace correlation, trust baselines, drift review, bounded payload analysis, host posture, pre-install candidate scans. https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe
- **OmaSafe bar plugin** (QML/Quickshell, v0.5.0): Plugins, Analysis, Rules, Posture and Source Scan views. https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe-plugin | https://plugins.omarchy.org/plugin.html?id=io.github.tuthan.omasafe
- **omasafe-plugin-review agent skill** (v1.4.0): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode. https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe-agent-skill

## Agent security projects

- **BlindPass**: Zero-knowledge secret provisioning for AI agents using HPKE (RFC 9180). Plaintext never reaches the LLM or the server. https://blindpass.atas.tech/
- **BlindDrop**: One-time, self-destructing secret sharing with client-side AES-GCM. https://blinddrop.atas.tech/
- **Dependency Guard** (v1.2.0): Supply-chain guardrail skill that reviews every dependency change with Socket before manifests or lockfiles change. Ships for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and ClawHub. https://clawhub.ai/tuthan/dependency-guard
